title: Do not waste a body built for meeting
summary: This body is a given chance, not a permanent possession. Use this day for what can still remain.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: This body is a given chance, not a permanent possession.
source.lifeApplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, answer the gift with one act of meeting.
